Hey you all!

Last week [b]Poster Sticker[/b] reached [i][u]"coming soon"[/u][/i] status so that game is waiting for getting released :)
The Steam page has finally been optimized suitable to the current state of the game.

We hope you are really looking forward to the release on [b]March, 2021![/b]

Thanks for your interested on [b]Poster Sticker[/b] and we're very excited what your feedback on the game will be!
